title: 美国参议院选战资金流向与广告支出变化
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Publicans do have more money collectively, but their candidates are trailing the Democratic candidates in terms of fundraising.
segments.zh: 共和党人总体上资金更充裕，但他们的候选人在筹款方面落后于民主党候选人。

segments.en: And the reason why this is important and advertising is that if you're a candidate, you get the lowest unit rate available when you're buying ad times.
segments.zh: 这一点在广告上很重要，因为作为候选人，购买广告时段时能享受最低单价。

segments.en: You get much more bang for your buck than a super PAC does.
segments.zh: 你的资金使用效率会比超级政治行动委员会高得多。

segments.en: The Supreme Court lifted those limits that a party can spend in coordination with a candidate where they can come up with the same message, they can figure out the strategy together.
segments.zh: 最高法院取消了政党与候选人协调支出的限制，他们可以统一口径，共同制定策略。

segments.en: So that's really kind of sort of leveling the playing field.
segments.zh: 这确实在一定程度上拉平了竞争环境。

segments.en: Bill Allison, you wrote last week that the National Republican Senatorial Committee outspent its Democratic counterpart on advertising by nearly 46 to 1 in August.
segments.zh: 比尔·艾利森，你上周写道，8月份全国共和党参议院委员会在广告上的支出几乎是民主党对手的46倍。

segments.en: Bill Ferries, I'll throw this to you. Is that a sign of strength from the Republican side or is it a sign that the Republican party is getting nervous about their positioning, again, even in these states that used to vote
segments.zh: 比尔·费里斯，我想问你，这是共和党实力的信号，还是表明共和党对自己在那些曾经可靠红州的定位感到紧张？

segments.en: reliably red? I'd say it's probably a sign of strength in some ways on the Republican side, but maybe what really jumps out at me is probably a sign of weakness on the Democratic side.
segments.zh: 可靠红州？我认为在某些方面这可能是共和党实力的信号，但真正让我注意的是，这可能是民主党弱点的信号。

segments.en: When we still talk to Democratic donors and strategists, we still hear them refer to the hangover from 2024.
segments.zh: 当我们与民主党捐助者和策略师交谈时，他们仍然提到2024年留下的后遗症。

segments.en: Their frustration that the Harris campaign went through more than a billion dollars and her brief run got defeated in pretty much all of the swing states.
segments.zh: 他们感到沮丧，因为哈里斯竞选团队花费了超过十亿美元，而她短暂的竞选在几乎所有摇摆州都失败了。
